propositions: The review-bot-ops runbook instructs operators to use SSM Session Manager but does not document the prod instance id or region needed to establish a session.
Operators cannot determine which AWS region to target for SSM operations without guessing, as the runbook lacks region documentation that exists only in terraform variables and backend configuration.

The autodeploy.sh script body auto-updates in-place via BOT_PATHS rsync, but script-only changes trigger no deploy so they must be hand-deployed; however, the installer and systemd unit files are re-materialization-excluded and always require hand-deployment.
The runbook must reference the authoritative terraform sources (var.aws_region default and versions.tf backend) for the prod region to prevent operator confusion.
